onset.Description: Event onset relative to the first EEG sample.

duration.Description: Event duration. Trials span start to end trigger; button presses are instantaneous (0).

Levels.alternating: AA / alternating action condition, black target: partners shoot alternately (condition code 1).
Levels.simultaneous: SA / simultaneous action condition, green target: partners shoot simultaneously (condition code 2).
Levels.free: F / blue target: partners shoot freely, no timing constraint (condition code 3).
Levels.buttonpress: A shot fired by this participant (shot-confirm pulse in the behavioural stream).

value.Description: Raw trial-type trigger code (XY: X=condition 1/2/3, Y=1 start). n/a for button presses.

shot_target.Description: For button presses, the target circle struck. 0 = miss (no circle hit). During a trial, values 1-3 equal the active condition code (each condition's on-screen targets are that colour): 1 = black (AA / alternating action), 2 = green (SA / simultaneous action), 3 = blue (F / free). 4 = white 'Bait' distractor participants were instructed to avoid (condition-independent). n/a for trial rows.

trial_number.Description: Trial index (1-90). For button presses, the trial during which the press occurred (n/a if between trials).

sample.Description: Onset in EEG samples (index into the recording at 1000 Hz).
